plan.notes: Source: TMCC official catalog 'Associate of General Studies' (https://catalog.tmcc.edu/degrees-certificates/ags/), 'Recommended Course Schedule' plan-of-study grid, hand-transcribed 2026-10-02. The AGS is a non-transfer degree designed for students who desire a well-rounded education for personal interest or further academic and/or career goals. The catalog defines its plan footnotes on this page: 1 = approved General Education list for the AGS Degree, 2 = 27 elective units with great latitude (any combination of career, technical, or general courses; developmental courses numbered less than 100 cannot be applied) — unspecified slots are modeled as choice slots with those definitions in choice_note; see advisor. Per-course prerequisites are not listed in the schedule grid. This program can be completed online but may require in-person assignments or exams.
